stories.title: US too focused on Middle East and not pushing Russia hard enough, Zelensky tells BBC
stories.body: Ukraine's president voices frustration with US and says it is "strange" Trump has described Vladimir Putin as a friend.

stories.title: Major Thanksgiving storm brings flooding, flight delays across US
stories.body: Almost one million customers in the US had no power on Thursday evening as storms descended on both US coasts, bringing wind gusts, heavy rain and flooding.

stories.title: Watch: Roofs torn off and streets under water as severe weather hits US
stories.body: Hundreds of thousands have been affected by storms in the country as the Thanksgiving holiday weekend begins.

stories.title: New Zealand's ruling coalition falls short of parliamentary majority by one seat
stories.body: The right-leaning ruling bloc led by the National Party has fallen short of the majority needed to govern.

stories.title: German boat dealer suspected of supplying Channel smuggling gangs, BBC finds
stories.body: Nearly a third of crossings in early 2026 allegedly involved boats or engines from the German man's firm.

stories.title: Watch: BBC confronts German man suspected of supplying migrant gangs with small boats
stories.body: Marvin Reuter is contesting extradition to France, where he could face smuggling, criminal conspiracy and involuntary manslaughter charges.

stories.title: Gérard Depardieu to stand trial for alleged rape of actress in 2018, court rules
stories.body: A Paris appeals court rules Depardieu will go on trial for the alleged rape of Charlotte Arnould.

stories.title: Diesel tanker carrying up to 7,000 tonnes capsizes near Ibiza, killing one
stories.body: The possible environmental damage is still being assessed by Spain's sea rescue service.

stories.title: Pregnant US inmate escapes in prison vehicle after medical appointment
stories.body: Rebecca Taylor had been imprisoned in New Mexico for multiple theft and burglary charges.

stories.title: Two Italians killed in strike in Kuwait, as Iran denies responsibility
stories.body: The pair were technicians for German company Rheinmetall, according to Italy's foreign ministry.

stories.title: Egyptian authorities arrest motorist over tanker crash that killed 31
stories.body: Officials say the man confessed to travelling at speed and clipping the fuel truck as he was overtaking traffic.

stories.title: Hope for millions as cheaper HIV prevention jab reaches Africa
stories.body: Lenacapavir, administered as an injection twice a year, is nearly 100% effective at preventing HIV infection.

stories.title: Myanmar refuses to comply with parts of ICJ genocide ruling
stories.body: A landmark ruling by the International Court of Justice (ICJ) convicted Myanmar of genocide against its Rohingya minority.

stories.title: Tributes for Duran Duran guitarist Andy Taylor after his death aged 65
stories.body: Simon Le Bon and his other bandmates say Taylor "brought an indelible fire and swagger to our music".

stories.title: Nine injured, three critically, after Bangkok oil refinery explosion
stories.body: Black smoke could be seen across Bangkok's skyline after the blast, as officials urged residents to leave the area.

stories.title: Politics and peek-a-boo in Australian parliament as senator brings baby to work
stories.body: Senator Lidia Thorpe kept 6-month-old Aaliyah entertained, as her mum Senator Fatima Payman, participated in an online safety bill debate.

stories.title: Hamas political official and wife among eight Palestinians killed in Israeli strikes on Gaza
stories.body: The killings are the latest from a series of near daily attacks by Israel against what it says are Hamas targets.

stories.title: Thirteen dead as mine disaster highlights illegal hunt for gold
stories.body: Indonesian authorities say another 13 are missing in the illegal gold mine, which flooded on Monday.

stories.title: DR Congo demands answers over Ugandan general's threats
stories.body: Gen Kainerugaba threatened a rebel takeover of a mineral-rich area in DR Congo in controversial X posts.

stories.title: New UK-EU treaty has 10-year termination clause
stories.body: Text of the treaties was published this afternoon, alongside legislation designed to enact the bulk of the deal.
